scope: target PID/FD KGSL validate, syncsource peek, GPUOBJ_INFO
one-reference target memfd read8 and AArch64 stat
transport: existing lsdriver shared request; original headers unchanged

validation.kernel_build: Per-module build.json records the compiled kernel, source, imports and page size

kernel_adaptation.purpose: local read-only xas_find_marked subset for GKI KMI; sprint_symbol spans instead of unexported kallsyms_lookup_size_offset

adaptations: Selected upstream request structures and command encodings are retained byte-for-byte; only the transport envelope is new.
Typed handlers use a private kernel payload; the dispatch kthread never copy_from_user/copy_to_user against the client.
KGSL holds the target PID/FD file directly and uses the fixed native GPUOBJ_INFO signature with CFI enabled.
Excluded IDs travel in legacy vmem_info scratch, are copied once, and keep the full upstream 4096-item limit.
Read-only xas_find_marked and its local helpers come from pinned Linux source, avoiding a KMI-unexported dependency.
Exported sprint_symbol provides the same offset/size span instead of unexported kallsyms_lookup_size_offset.
Memory reads retain the existing Swap-aware lsdriver reader; no upstream NC reader or install hook is imported.
GKI-unexported kernel_read and vfs_getattr use exact typed runtime symbol lookup; builds verify both symbols in System.map.
KernelServices supplies all simulation environment queries for both custom read modes; Unicorn remains in userspace.
Android 5.10 Bionic VMA names use target-mm GUP and balanced page references, matching fs/proc/task_mmu.c; newer kernels retain kernel-owned name objects.
Android 5.10 CONFIG_USER_NS=n copies valid UID/GID values directly and resolves overflow sysctl variables only for invalid IDs, avoiding KMI-unexported overflowgid without gating ordinary stat.
